I'm seeking a Mid-Market/Majors Account Executive to partner with businesses in identifying bottlenecks and leveraging AI to drive meaningful impact. This role is perfect for process-oriented professionals who can delve into business workflows, uncover inefficiencies, and deliver strategic solutions that yield real results.

Key reasons to consider ClickUp:

- The Everything App for Work: Replace multiple tools with a single, unified platform.
- AI at the Core: Assist organizations in streamlining workflows and enhancing productivity with cutting-edge AI.
- Massive Market Opportunity: Engage with a broad total addressable market across various industries and company sizes.
- High-Growth Environment: Join one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies that is shaping the future of work.
- Impact-Driven Sales: Provide measurable ROI by addressing real business challenges.
- World-Class Culture: Collaborate with innovative, driven, and customer-focused teammates.

If you are interested or know someone who would be a great fit, please DM me.

items.text:
$300M ARR - A Milestone Worth Celebrating

Hitting $300 million ARR is more than just a number - it’s a moment to pause and reflect on how far we’ve come as a team, a company, and a community of customers and partners.

Take a few minutes to check out this video of our CFO, Dan Zhang, sharing what Converged AI means and how ClickUp is leading the charge: https://lnkd.in/ede3Hpn2

This milestone is proof that we’ve built something that scales - not just in revenue, but in trust and impact.

It’s a reminder that sustainable growth comes from staying disciplined, focused, and customer-first.

And it’s motivation to keep pushing - because milestones are not finish lines, they’re launch pads.







#ClickUp #Growth #ARR #ConvergedAI

repost_content.text:
ClickUp just blew past $300M ARR. But we're not just celebrating a number.

We're stopping to celebrate the entire journey - before we move the goal post again.

And this journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. We’ve grown from a small team with a huge dream into a global company helping 20M+ people maximize their productivity.

7 years ago, we set out with an ambitious vision.

We built ClickUp to end the chaos of work sprawl and converge many software categories together. We started when "one app" was seen as the wrong strategy, but today it's the only strategy to realize our mission of making people more productive.

Because 100% context is the single most important thing for enabling human productivity from AI.

So, this milestone? We stop. We breathe. We practice gratitude. We celebrate.

To our customers: Thank you so much for believing in us, and for sticking with us through growing pains.

To our teams: I'm infinitely grateful for how much you care, it energizes me to keep going every single day.

We’re just getting started. Thank you to everyone who’s been part of this story. 💜
